court: In the High Court of Madras
judges: (Before Dr Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan
judges_raw: (Before Dr Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan, JJ.)
respondents: Additional Chief Secretary to Government and Others
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. R. Muniyapparaj Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr. M. Sylvester John
prayer: Prayer: Habeas Corpus Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of habeas corpus to call for the records pertaining to the order of detention passed by the second respondent in his proceedings in No. 643/BBCDEFGISSSV/2025 dated 4-9-2025 and quash the same as illegal and produce the detenu, namely, Syed Nadeem, S/o. Syed Shanavaz, aged 21 years, Goonda, now he is confined in Central Prison, Puzhal II, Chennai, before this Court and set him at liberty.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Mr R. Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, states that nothing survives in this matter as the detention order dated 4-9-2025 passed against the detenu has been revoked by the Government by its order in G.O.Rt. No. 6702 Home, Prohibition and Excise (XIII) Department, dated 16-10-2025, recording which, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed. No costs.
